conviction_note: No usable option chain and a 2-3 analyst bar. The evidence is a modest positive on the number: the ADAS line (WRD 3.0 on GAC Aion N60 and the 2027 i60) and the robotaxi fleet ramp support a Q3 revenue near or a little above the RMB 270-274M bar, and Pony's 18 Nov print beat on revenue and robotaxi revenue. The reaction function is weak, though: WRD fell 9.7% on an 82% revenue print in August, and Pony gave up an 11% pre-market gain to close about 5% lower on 18 Nov. The stock is at a 52-week low after -21.5% in five sessions and -10% intraday on 19 Nov, and the short book was 9.1 days to cover on 30 Oct, so a squeeze is a live mechanism. That leaves p_up just above 50 (52) on a ~10% absolute move. The findings sum to +0.6 and the scaled number is +0.4; both are small and they agree in sign.

The two sources agree, but the bar is thin. Q3 EPS: -0.99 (1 analyst, Yahoo) or -0.772 CNY (3 analysts, finanzen.net), disputed or unclear in currency. findings.finding: Pony AI, the closest listed peer, reported Q3 2026 before the open on 18 Nov: revenue $44.6M (RMB 298.8M), +75.2% YoY and ahead of estimates; robotaxi revenue more than doubled to $17.8M (+165%); non-GAAP loss -$0.11 vs -$0.15 consensus. GAAP net loss more than doubled, mainly on a $77M non-cash fair-value loss. The stock was up ~11% pre-market, then traded down ~5.3% to $3.78 by mid-session. The fundamental read-through for China and Middle East robotaxi demand is positive, but this sector's tape currently sells a revenue beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: WRD's own: Q2 2026 (12 Aug) revenue +82% YoY and +103% QoQ, and the ADR closed -9.7% at $5.72 (jiemian). Q3 2025 (24 Nov 2025) revenue +144%, ADR up ~15% (tikr). Peer Pony on 18 Nov: beat, then faded about 16 points from the pre-market high.
findings.why_not_priced: The demand read-through is partly priced: WRD fell 10% on 19 Nov, the day after Pony's beat, which suggests the market read Pony as 'beats get sold' rather than 'demand is strong'. If the market had priced the positive demand read, WRD would have firmed after Pony instead of making new lows.
findings.independence: The Pony release itself (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/11/18/3405413/0/en/pony-ai-inc-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results-total-revenues-up-75-2-yoy-to-us-44-6-million-with-robotaxi-services-revenues-growing-by-165-4-yoy.html) gives the same numbers; one fact, filed once. The reaction part comes only from investing.com.

findings.finding: The L2++/L3 (WRD 3.0) line is ramping into H2. Q2 revenue on this line rose 219% QoQ on ~30,000 units and lifted gross margin to 37.5% (company Q2 release). In Q3 GAC Aion, the main WRD 3.0 customer, sold 35,494 units in September (+21.9% YoY, seventh straight month of YoY growth). The N60, co-developed with WeRide and launched in April, passed 20,000 users in under five months. The 2027 AION i60, shipping with WRD 3.0 from delivery from 15 Sep, took 20,000+ orders in September. This supports Q3 ADAS at least flat to Q2 and a Q4 step-up, which the RMB 513.5M Q4 consensus requires.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In Q2 2026 L2++/L3 revenue grew 2,594% YoY and 219% QoQ with a record 37.5% gross margin, and the stock still closed -9.7%. The line has not been paid on its last print.
findings.why_not_priced: Neither Aion sales nor i60 orders are carried by US-side WRD coverage. They are a Chinese auto-sales series, and consensus has 2 analysts on the quarter. If this were priced, the Q3 estimate range would not start at RMB 234.7M, roughly flat on Q2's RMB 231.7M. On the other side, the management target (>100k L2++/L3 vehicles by YE2026) implies H2 deliveries of roughly Q2's run-rate, so a step-change in Q3 itself is not established. Proxy: Aion brand totals, not WRD 3.0 unit counts.
findings.independence: Separate documents: the WeRide/GAC release on the 2027 i60 (https://finviz.com/news/392122/wrd-30-powers-the-aion-i60-with-championship-winning-technology-available-from-delivery, 2026-09-15) and the WeRide Q2 release (https://ir.weride.ai/zh-hans/node/9266/pdf, 2026-08-12) with the 30,000-unit figure. Net of the rest of the company: L4 (robotaxi plus robobus) was 54% of Q2 revenue, and its product sales are lumpy.

findings.finding: The bar is back-end loaded with no company guide behind it. FY2026 consensus of RMB 1.05-1.06B (11-15 analysts) against H1 actual of RMB 345.9M requires H2 of about RMB 705-715M, roughly twice H1. Q4 consensus is RMB 513.5M (+64% YoY over Q4'25's RMB 314M, which held RMB 211M of lumpy product revenue). WeRide gives no numeric revenue guidance, so call commentary that does not underwrite a ~2x Q4 step-up is a downside risk on the forward line.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no numeric guide history. On the Q2 2026 call management stated cash-flow targets (positive quarter by 2028, break-even 2029) and fleet targets, not a revenue guide, and the stock fell 9.7% on the day.
findings.why_not_priced: The H2 arithmetic is visible to anyone who adds up the quarters, so it is partly priced; the -21.5% five-day run-in may already hold some of it. A fully priced version would show FY estimates being cut ahead of the print, and the Yahoo EPS trend shows no such cut (FY2026 EPS -4.52 vs -4.61 thirty days ago). Inference from consensus arithmetic, not a document.
findings.independence: finanzen.net (https://finanzen.net/nachricht/aktien/ausblick-weride-stellt-quartalsergebnis-zum-abgelaufenen-jahresviertel-vor-16075391) gives FY RMB 1.05B from 15 analysts, the same consensus. Offsetting: the 2,600-robotaxi YE target (1,800 at end-July) and Geely Farizon's plan to deliver 2,000 GXRs in 2026 provide a product-sales path for Q4. Shrunk for the crowded short.

findings.finding: In-quarter L4 commercial milestones: WeRide, Uber and AVOMO received Spain's first national L4 passenger operating permit (10 Sep). Grab's Q3 release (3 Nov) confirmed that the WeRide-built Ai.R service is operating in Punggol, Singapore, with a plan to expand fivefold to ~50 vehicles. Uber's Q3 call (4 Nov) targeted ~700 fully driverless vehicles on its network by YE2026, and WeRide is its driverless partner in Abu Dhabi and Dubai (Middle East fleet ~400 at end-July).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Partnership and permit news has repeatedly failed to hold: an earlier itiger item says the stock fell two days running on an Uber tie-up. Overseas revenue +164% in Q2 did not prevent a -9.7% day.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: these are press releases and counterparty calls already in the wire. The unpriced part is only whether the overseas robotaxi count at the print (vs ~400 Middle East and 1,800 global at end-July) puts the 2,600 YE target on track.
findings.independence: Grab Q3 2026 release (https://www.grab.com/sg/press/others/grab-reports-third-quarter-2026-results-raises-full-year-guidance/, 2026-11-03) and Uber Q3 coverage (https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/uber-ceo-targets-700-fully-driverless-vehicles-by-year-end-over-2000-by-2027/cNGLXAwR93K) are separate counterparties.

findings.finding: The ADR goes into the print capitulated and crowded short. Short interest was 19.87M ADS, 9.1 days to cover on 30 Oct, up from 16.6M and 5.3 days on 30 Sep. Spot is $3.295, the 52-week low, after -21.5% in five sessions and -10.2% intraday on 19 Nov. Volume on 19 Nov was ~2.46M by 13:13 EST against 2.24M 20-day average. Any revenue print at or above the RMB 270M bar, or a firm Q4 comment, meets a short base that needs over a week of volume to cover.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025: after a -49% YTD drawdown, the print was bought ~+15%. Q2 2026: after a smaller run-in, the print was sold -9.7%. These are mixed signals on whether capitulation into a print reverses.
findings.why_not_priced: Short interest is public but the settlement is 3 weeks old; the 9.1 days figure predates the latest -21% leg, so the current short base may be larger. If the squeeze risk were priced, the ADR would not have made a new low on above-average volume the day before the print. Part of the drawdown has a cause (Pony's fade and Waller's 18 Nov rate comments), so this is not purely an unexplained drop.
findings.independence: Curvedtrading and stockmarketwatch, via search, give 16.6M and 5.3-5.4 days at 30 Sep, consistent with a rising short base. The tape figures are in the sealed baseline (run_up_5d_pct -21.55). Not independent of the macro item in finding 1's document.

baseline_tension: The baseline holds no options view, only a sharp negative run-in to a 52-week low. My evidence leans mildly positive on the number and the positioning, which cuts against the momentum. The reaction function (this name and its peer sold their last beats) pulls p_up back toward 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction): WRD fell 9.7% on its 82% Q2 print and Pony faded its beat, so the WRD 3.0 ramp finding went from +1.0 to +0.6.

Lesson 5 (an unexplained drawdown is worth 0; positioning does not file on its own): the capitulation/crowded-short finding went from +1.5 to +0.8. It is kept because short interest of 9.1 days to cover is a sourced fact and the drawdown has partial causes (Pony's fade, Waller).
Lesson 7 (a crowded short shrinks a negative): the back-end-loaded bar finding went from -0.8 to -0.6.
Lesson 2 (one-offs are one-offs): the Jingshuo financing went from +0.2 to +0.1, since it has no path to revenue or the guide.

Lesson 6 (verify the bar): the bar has two agreeing estimate sources (RMB 269.9M and 273.9M) but only 2-3 analysts, so sizes stay small. The permits finding went from +0.3 to +0.2 because it is wire copy.
Lesson 8 (thin coverage means bigger moves): abs_move_pct is kept at 10 rather than shrunk; p_up moved from 53 to 52.
